questions.question: For an even number of amounts, which real value should the median use?

options.label: Lower middle value
options.adds: For an even number of amounts, take the lower of the two middle amounts.

options.label: Upper middle value
options.adds: For an even number of amounts, take the upper of the two middle amounts.

options.label: Closest to mean
options.adds: For an even number of amounts, take whichever of the two middle amounts is closer to the mean.

rewriteBeforeAnswers: Change the median calculation so it always returns an amount that was actually spent, meaning one of the real values in the data, not a figure averaged between two entries. Change nothing else, and don't add tests, docs, or files. Done when the existing tests pass.
